meta.title: Multi-Channel Subscription & Bar Aggregation
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Implement multi-channel subscription and bar aggregation from trade ticks for complete live market data.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Multiple channel subscriptions work: trades, orderbook, candlestick
BarBuffer aggregates trades into OHLCV bars, pushes on timeframe boundary
Orderbook data parsed correctly with bids and asks
Unsubscribe works, no more messages for unsubscribed channels

key-tasks.task: Implement multi-channel support with message routing
Implement BarBuffer integration (create per symbol/timeframe, feed ticks)

architecture-context.pattern: Route messages to appropriate handlers based on type.
BarBuffer aggregates TickData into OHLCV bars.
